PowerUp_HeroSpawn_BladeChampion.description: When picked up by a friendly unit, deploys <style="Faction_Custodes">Kariyan</style> onto the battlefield. They can be controlled like other friendly <style="Character">characters</style>. If possible, they try to deploy onto the hex of an enemy unit, and the enemy on that hex is <style="Obliterated">always overkilled</style>.
